command: Human PIK3C3 participates in pexophagy (GO:0000425) and localizes to the peroxisome (GO:0005777). Adjudicate these two claims independently. Identify the catalytic and complex machinery for mammalian pexophagy and distinguish localization on an engulfing autophagic membrane from residency on the peroxisomal cargo. Assess conservation from experimentally characterized VPS34 orthologs without requiring a new experiment for every conserved role.

recovery.method: Supported provider artifact extraction and ResearchProcessor export; exact provider report preserved. No resubmission.
